description: Ordered stages the RunGrid controller executes autonomously between true founder gates. Each stage writes disk evidence and advances without a founder prompt relay.

stages.name: preflight
hold_if: repo dirty in a way blocking work

stages.name: lane_plan
actions: select <=3 wide-safe lanes with disjoint owned paths
hold_if: any lane needs a prohibited path

stages.name: build
actions: each builder implements only in owned paths

stages.name: machine_verify
actions: browser/a11y if safely runnable else UNKNOWN

stages.name: gate_advisor
actions: separate read-only Gate Advisor emits verdict

stages.name: reconcile
actions: local integration into isolated worktree (no merge)

advance_rule: Terminal-0 advances stage N->N+1 automatically while gate=='internal' and no hold_if fires. It STOPS only at a true_founder_gate or a fired stop condition.
